description: Get one The Standard Reserve (TSR) S-Bill by id, or list S-Bills filtered by owner and/or status, on Robinhood Chain: principal, premium, locked rate, maturity, settlement and how each closed. The single-bill form (pass billId) also returns the bill's full event history and live exit_quote/redeem_quote cross-checks when the bill is still active; the contract quotes a redemption only after maturity, so until then redeem_quote is null and redeem_quote_reason says why. The contract has no automatic roll; the owner must call roll after maturity. The list form is keyset-paginated on bill_id descending; pass the previous response's next_before back as before to fetch the next page. Fields ending in _raw are 18-decimal integers as strings.

before.description: When listing: exclusive descending cursor, a bill_id from the previous response's next_before.

billId.description: Bill id. Omit to list S-Bills instead.

owner.description: Owner address (0x...) to filter by. Any casing is accepted — the gateway lowercases it.
